Result: 前沿模型在合作和欺骗角色上都表现优异，形成了GPT-5.4、Kimi K2.5、Grok 4.1 Fast和DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus的顶级四强集群。最弱模型表现低于随机基线（33%）和简单算法基线（45%）。大多数LLM难以在整个游戏中保持一致的欺骗人设，欺骗保持率低于50%。

Conclusion: ParliamentBench能有效区分不同模型在信息不对称条件下的欺骗和推理能力。当前模型间存在显著能力差距，且欺骗一致性的保持仍是大多数LLM的薄弱环节，这对模型的安全部署具有重要警示意义。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as agents in high-stakes settings, such as medical and legal systems, understanding their deceptive capabilities is fundamental to safety. Controlled social deduction games provide a reproducible proxy for isolating and evaluating these complex adversarial behaviors. We present the open-source benchmark framework ParliamentBench based on the game Secret Hitler to evaluate LLMs in scenarios that require deception, persuasion, and reasoning under information asymmetry. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 1,600 simulated matches playing each other, playing against humans, and compare them against a large set of online games. We introduce three novel metrics that isolate social deduction, reasoning, and deceptive consistency. Our experiments reveal that frontier models achieve strong performance across cooperative and deceptive roles, with a strong top-four cluster (GPT-5.4, Kimi K2.5, Grok 4.1 Fast, and DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus), whereas the weakest models fall short of random (33%) and simple algorithmic (45%) baselines. Most LLMs struggle to maintain a consistent deceptive persona throughout an entire game, with deception retention dropping below 50%.

</details>


### [150] [RRM: Experience-Driven Reflective Retrieval Memory for Long-Horizon Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28156)
*Jingxiang Fan,Junbao Zhuo,Bochao Zou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RRM是一个面向长时间多模态推理的反思式检索记忆框架，通过将历史轨迹中的可迁移检索知识蒸馏为反思经验记忆，并结合生命周期管理机制减少冗余与噪声，在多个长视频基准上超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时记忆智能体主要关注存储内容而忽视检索策略；当检索不准确或反复失败时，缺乏从失败轨迹中诊断问题并调整搜索策略的机制。

Method: 1）构建实体中心多模态记忆图；2）引入反思经验记忆，从历史任务轨迹中蒸馏可迁移的程序性检索知识；3）检索到的经验转化为查询级指导，回答生成仍仅依赖当前视频的新检索事实证据；4）通过生命周期管理机制（使用频率、复用反馈、时间衰减）调控经验记忆，减少冗余和噪声。

Result: 在M3-Bench-Robot、M3-Bench-Web和Video-MME-Long三个基准上一致超越此前SOTA方法，验证了反思式检索记忆在长时间多模态推理中的有效性。

Conclusion: 反思经验记忆能有效捕获跨任务的复用检索策略，且通过查询级指导而非直接参与答案生成，避免噪声污染；生命周期管理进一步保障了记忆的质量与可扩展性。

Abstract: Existing multimodal long-term memory agents use external memory to overcome the limited context available for long videos. However, most methods emphasize what to store rather than how stored memory should be retrieved. When retrieval becomes inaccurate or repeatedly fails to obtain useful evidence, existing agents lack mechanisms to diagnose failures from previous task trajectories and adapt future search strategies.We introduce Reflective Retrieval Memory (RRM), a reflective memory framework for long-horizon multimodal reasoning. RRM augments an entity-centric multimodal memory graph with reflective experience memory, which distills transferable procedural retrieval knowledge from historical task trajectories. Unlike episodic and semantic memories that preserve factual evidence from the current video, reflective experience memory captures reusable search strategies across tasks. RRM converts retrieved experiences into query-level guidance, while answer generation remains conditioned only on factual evidence newly retrieved from the current video. A lifecycle management mechanism further regulates experience memory through usage frequency, reuse feedback, and temporal decay, thereby reducing redundancy and noise. RRM consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches on M3-Bench-Robot, M3-Bench-Web, and Video-MME-Long, demonstrating the effectiveness of reflective retrieval memory for long-horizon multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [151] [Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28166)
*Chia-Ming Lee,Ming-Ching Chang,Xin Li,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Chung Hsu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LATCH，一个无需训练的候选感知早期退出框架，用于加速扩散语言模型（DLM）的解码。LATCH包含两个独立机制：Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC)通过格式感知的确定性解析器验证置信度和argmax稳定性来决定全局终止；Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC)通过局部规则加速非最终块的解码。在11个任务、22个设置下，LATCH保持准确率损失在2.0个百分点以内，同时实现短答案任务9.3-17.8x和长推理任务2.0-3.3x的端到端TPS加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤都会暴露临时预测，这为生成时早期退出提供了机会。然而，现有的早期退出门控方法依赖固定区域的置信度统计或调度依赖规则，证据过于粗糙，无法在冻结所有剩余位置时做出可靠决策，特别是在长链式推理输出中容易过早触发。此外，自适应采样虽然能控制位置提交速度，但从不验证输出本身是否已稳定。因此需要一种新的框架，将终止决策和加速决策分离，并使每个决策匹配其对应范围的证据。

Method: LATCH框架包含两个独立但互补的机制：(1) Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC)负责全局终止决策，通过任务输出格式指定的确定性解析器动态提取候选跨度，并验证置信度与持续argmax稳定性；(2) Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC)负责局部加速，对非最终块应用更便宜的局部规则，同时将最终块和全局终止决策留给CVC。该方法无需后缀提示构造，是提示无关但格式感知的，完全无需训练。

Result: 在LLaDA和Dream两个骨干网络上、11个任务、22个评估设置下进行零样本端到端评估。LATCH在所有设置中与完整解码的准确率差距保持在2.0个百分点以内，使用一组冻结的超参数可跨骨干网络直接迁移而无需调参。端到端TPS加速方面，短答案任务达到9.3-17.8倍，长推理任务达到2.0-3.3倍。

Conclusion: LATCH通过将全局终止决策（CVC）与局部加速决策（BWEC）分离，并利用候选感知的证据（格式感知的确定性解析器验证置信度和argmax稳定性），有效解决了现有早期退出方法在长推理任务中过早触发的问题。该方法在保持高准确率的同时实现了显著的加速，且无需训练、无需调参即可跨模型迁移。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adaptive sampling, the other axis of training-free acceleration, paces how quickly positions commit while decoding continues but never verifies that the output itself has stabilized. We introduce a training-free, candidate-aware early-exit framework that keeps the two axes separate and matches each decision to evidence of its own scope. Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) governs when the sequence may stop by verifying confidence and sustained argmax stability over the dynamically extracted candidate span using a deterministic parser specified from each task's output format. Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) governs where to accelerate by applying a cheaper local rule to non-final blocks, while leaving the final block and global termination under CVC. We refer to their combination as LATCH (Localized Acceleration with Tracked-Candidate Halting). Unlike prior methods, LATCH needs no suffix-prompt construction; it is prompt-anchor-free but format-aware. We evaluate LATCH end to end on 11 tasks under zero-shot settings using LLaDA and Dream. LATCH stays within 2.0 percentage points of full-decoding accuracy across all 22 evaluation settings, with one frozen hyperparameter set that transfers cross-backbone untuned, while achieving end-to-end TPS speedups of 9.3-17.8x on short-answer tasks and 2.0-3.3x on long-reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [152] [The MADRS Pipeline: Supporting Depression Assessment in Clinical Trials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28190)
*Mila Fodor,Katalin Ócsai,Francesco Periti,Rien Sonck,Alex Boudreau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的流水线，用于支持临床试验中抑郁症的MADRS量表评估。该流水线将音频访谈转录为文本，映射到十个MADRS症状项目，评估严重程度，并识别有问题的临床评分。在真实临床访谈中，与专家评分的总体相关性达到0.867。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁症的诊断主要依赖临床评估，而现有的自动化方法大多聚焦于在线文本或社交媒体等非临床来源，缺乏对临床试验场景的支持——在该场景中，临床评估通过基于SIGMA等标准指南的结构化访谈进行。因此需要一种专门为临床试验设计、能够辅助临床医生评估抑郁症状的自动化工具。

Method: 构建了一个LLM流水线，包含以下步骤：1) 将音频访谈转换为文本转录；2) 将转录文本映射到MADRS量表的十个症状项目；3) 评估各症状的严重程度；4) 识别与各症状相关的有问题的临床评分。

Result: 在真实临床访谈数据上的评估显示，该方法与专家评分之间具有较强的总体相关性（相关系数0.867），为临床试验中未来的评估提供了可解释的支持。

Conclusion: 该LLM流水线能够有效支持临床试验中抑郁症的MADRS量表自动化评估，与专家评分高度一致，具有良好的可解释性，有望成为未来临床试验评估的有力辅助工具。

Abstract: Depression is a major mental disorder for which diagnosis relies primarily on clinical assessments. Automated methods to support its detection via the psychiatric MADRS scale are getting more and more attention. While existing solutions primarily focus on detecting the disorder from different text sources (e.g., online text, social media), there is still limited support for clinical trials, where clinical assessments are conducted through structured interviews based on standard guidelines such as SIGMA. In this work, we develop a LLM pipeline specifically designed to support clinicians in supporting the assessment of depression in patients enrolled in clinical trials. Our pipeline converts audio interviews into transcripts, maps them into the ten MADRS symptom items, estimates their severity, and identify problematic clinical ratings associated with them. Evaluation on real clinical interviews shows a strong overall correlation of 0.867 with expert ratings, providing interpretable support for future assessments in clinical trials.

</details>


### [153] [Fidelity Is Not Safety: Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Data-Free Quality Guard Yet Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28196)
*I. Kennedy,T. Kennedy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现当前压缩语言模型的质量评估标准（困惑度、下游准确率如MMLU、数据无关的输出保真度）存在盲区：温和压缩（尤其低秩SVD截断）的模型能通过所有常规质检，但在作为智能体执行标准操作流程（SOP）时会编造指令中不存在的程序步骤。该效应是算子特异的（SVD诱发、幅度剪枝不诱发），机制轴为压缩误差的相干性乘以误差率，而非损坏幅度。作者提出一个数据无关的双轴统计量作为筛选器，固定阈值可跨架构识别问题构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有压缩模型验收流程（困惑度、MMLU、输出保真度）虽然数据廉价，但存在盲区：无法发现压缩模型作为智能体时编造操作步骤的安全隐患。作者希望揭示这一盲区、隔离其因果机制，并提供可用的数据无关筛选方案。

Method: 在三个模型家族中进行预注册、有统计功效的canary测试（发明步骤检测），对温和压缩（低秩SVD）与幅度剪枝进行对比；使用配对置信区间隔离相干压缩误差的作用；构建双轴统计量（相干分数×误差率）作为数据无关筛选器，验证其固定阈值的跨架构普适性。

Result: 低秩SVD压缩模型在所有传统质检通过的情况下，在SOP智能体任务中系统性地编造步骤；幅度剪枝在相同困惑度下不诱发此现象。配对输出保真度测试通过但发明步骤canary失败的解离确认了该盲区。双轴统计量（相干分数与误差率）以固定阈值准确标记问题构建，且跨三种架构一致。

Conclusion: 困惑度、MMLU和保真度验收不能证明智能体安全。压缩误差的相干性是关键机制轴而非损坏幅度。部署温和压缩的低秩构建前，应使用数据无关的双轴误差统计量进行筛选，以规避智能体场景下的程序发明风险。

Abstract: Practitioners accept a compressed language model once it clears a stack of data-cheap quality guards: perplexity within a small factor of the original, downstream accuracy (for example MMLU) inside a confidence interval, and data-free output-fidelity signals that compare the compressed and original network's internal representations under random probe inputs. This stack has a blind spot. Across three model families, gently-compressed models clear every guard and then invent procedure steps that were never in the instructions when they run a standard operating procedure (SOP) as an agent. The effect is operator-specific: coherent low-rank (SVD) truncation induces it, and magnitude pruning matched to the same perplexity does not. One dissociation isolates the cause. The same compressed weights that CI-win a paired output-fidelity test CI-fail the invented-step canary. The governing axis is the coherence of the compression error times its rate; the magnitude of the damage does not predict it. The data-free fidelity probe is a fidelity oracle by construction, so it cannot see this axis. We characterize the blindspot and dissociation with paired confidence intervals on a pre-registered, powered canary across three architectures. Operator-specificity replicates on all three, and the perplexity-guard evasion appears where the model admits in-guard low-rank headroom. We then give a data-free screen: a two-axis statistic of the compression error (coherent-fraction and error-rate) that flags the failing builds with fixed thresholds across architectures and matches the coherence-times-rate mechanism. Perplexity, MMLU, and fidelity acceptance do not certify agent safety. Screen gently-compressed low-rank builds before agentic deployment

</details>


### [154] [Causal Discovery with Inverted Self-attention for Multivariate Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28212)
*Yusen Liu,Yong Wang,Yifan Yin,Tianqing Zhu,Xiufeng Liu,Huan Huo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于Transformer自注意力机制的新型因果发现框架，通过倒置因果自注意力机制（CSAM）强调潜在和间接因果关系，并结合全局因果算法和因果验证模块，在多元时间序列数据上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元时间序列数据中的因果发现面临复杂交互、高维性和非线性依赖关系的挑战，现有方法难以准确捕捉这些复杂性，导致因果结构不准确。

Method: 1) 提出倒置因果自注意力机制（CSAM）：通过倒置token并引入注意力分数稀疏化，聚焦显著因果交互并减少虚假相关性；2) 开发全局因果算法识别全局因果链接，提供因果影响的整体度量；3) 构建因果验证模块确保识别因果关系的鲁棒性。

Result: 在线性和非线性数据集上的实验、消融研究和敏感性分析表明，该框架优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 该框架在复杂多元时间序列因果发现中展现出潜力，验证了自注意力机制结合倒置技术与稀疏化策略的有效性。

Abstract: Causal discovery in multivariate time series data is challenging due to complex interactions, high dimensionality, and nonlinear dependencies among variables. Existing methods often struggle to capture these complexities, resulting in inaccurate causal structures. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that leverages self-attention mechanisms within the transformer architecture for causal discovery. Our approach introduces a novel inverted causal self-attention mechanism (CSAM) that emphasizes latent and indirect causal relationships by inverting tokens and inducing sparsity in attention scores, focusing on significant causal interactions and reducing spurious correlations. Additionally, we develop a global causal algorithm to identify global causal links, providing a holistic metric for causal influence, along with a causal verification module to ensure robustness in the identified causal relationships, enhancing the reliability of our framework. Experiments on both linear and nonlinear datasets, along with ablation studies and sensitivity analyses, show that our framework outperforms existing methods, demonstrating its potential for causal discovery in complex multivariate time series.

</details>


### [155] [Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28263)
*Hanzuo Liu,Xuan Qi,Chunyu Liu,Haotian Zhong,Yulong Wang,Rayying,Key,Alex Lamb,Mingyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CoMem（Comprehension Memory）是一种利用Transformer层间分工来组织长上下文记忆的方法：只在中间层写入上下文块，检索固定数量的缓存残差状态，并仅在上层进行查询条件化的重计算，从而让模型侧读取计算和内存与存储上下文长度无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的不同层承担不同职责——浅层和中层构建语义表征，高层则将其特化用于预测。作者希望利用这种层间分工，将长上下文记忆沿着"层轴"而非仅沿"token轴"来组织，从而突破长上下文推理中计算和内存随上下文长度线性增长的瓶颈。

Method: CoMem将上下文块仅通过中间层写入，检索固定数量的缓存残差状态，然后对检索到的pack进行查询条件化的上层重计算。模型使用冻结的Qwen3-8B主干，训练rank-32自蒸馏LoRA（基于PG19），并配置了无需adapter的对照实验。

Result: CoMem在RULER上达到97.05，在LoCoMo上达到38.27（对比全上下文KV-Direct的34.59）；对话记忆优势在对话簇重采样和独立评测下依然稳健。在NVIDIA H20上128k上下文时，内存从89.36GB降至18.26GB，prefill加速7.83倍。

Conclusion: 长上下文记忆可以沿着层轴而非仅token轴进行组织，受控的深度扫描表明更深的缓存降低每次查询的重计算量但带来保真度损失，而自蒸馏能显著修复这一损失。

Abstract: Transformer depth is not used uniformly: lower and middle layers build semantic representations, while upper layers increasingly specialize them for prediction. We turn this division of labor into CoMem (Comprehension Memory), which writes each context chunk only through an intermediate layer, retrieves a fixed number of cached residual states, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers over the resulting pack. For a fixed retrieval budget, model-side read compute and memory are independent of stored-context length. We evaluate a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM under a unified chat-template-free protocol. The backbone is frozen; the flagship trains only a rank-32 self-distillation LoRA on plain PG19, and we report an adapter-free arm separately. CoMem reaches 97.05 on RULER and 38.27 on LoCoMo versus 34.59 for full-context KV-Direct; the dialogue-memory advantage survives conversation-cluster resampling and an independent judge. Results on additional long-context and long-document tasks expose both the benefits of bounded retrieval and its in-window compression tax. Controlled depth sweeps show that deeper caching lowers per-query recomputation but incurs a fidelity loss that self-distillation substantially repairs. In a separate adapter-free efficiency control on an NVIDIA H20 at 128k, CoMem uses 18.26 GB rather than 89.36 GB and achieves a 7.83x prefill speedup. These results show that long-context memory can be organized along the layer axis, not only the token axis.

</details>


### [156] [MORFES: A Benchmark for Productive Inflectional Competence in Modern Greek](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28274)
*Ioakeim Perros,Cleopatra Papadopoulou,Ayoub Kirouane,Christos Petrocheilos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MORFES，一个用于评估现代希腊语屈折形态能力的基准测试集，包含500个专家验证的项目，测试屈折形式的识别与生成，优先使用低频词条以确保答案反映规则而非记忆。作者还发布了自研模型Sophea-Genesis-1，其在屈折形态任务上领先，同时在其他通用能力上与同规模模型持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代希腊语是一种屈折丰富的语言，但现有的语言模型评估主要集中于事实性知识，缺乏专门评估其屈折形态能力的基准。作者希望填补这一空白，并评估快速扩展的开源模型生态中形态学丰富的语言的语法能力。

Method: 构建了MORFES基准测试集，包含500个专家验证的测试条目，涵盖屈折形式的识别与生成两个任务；通过选取低频词条确保正确回答反映屈折规则而非记忆的词汇形式。同时开发了Sophea-Genesis-1模型，并在一系列开源模型（LLaMA、Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Magistral、Kimi K2等）上进行评估。

Result: 在评估的多个开源模型中，作者自研的Sophea-Genesis-1在屈折形态任务上表现最佳，同时在通用能力上与同规模模型相当。基准和模型均已在Hugging Face上开源。

Conclusion: MORFES为评估多形态丰富语言的屈折能力提供了首个专门基准，填补了评测空白；自研模型Sophea-Genesis-1证明了在保持通用能力的同时可以实现更强的屈折形态性能。

Abstract: Modern Greek is a richly inflected language, yet the language models built for it are evaluated mainly on factual knowledge, and no benchmark is dedicated to their inflectional competence. We introduce MORFES (Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite), a benchmark of 500 expert-verified items that tests the recognition and production of Greek inflected forms, favoring lower-frequency lemmas so that a correct answer reflects the rule rather than a memorized form. We make it publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES. We evaluate a range of open language models on MORFES, situating them within the rapidly scaling open-weight ecosystem from LLaMA to Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Magistral, and Kimi K2, where multilingual coverage grows but grammatical competence in morphologically rich languages remains under-measured. Among them, Sophea-Genesis-1, a model we developed and release as open weights at https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1, leads on inflectional morphology while matching similarly sized models in general capability.

</details>


### [157] [(Towards) Scalable Reliable Automated Evaluation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28282)
*Bertil Braun,Martin Forell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多LLM成对比较和Elo评分系统的评估框架，用于近似专家级评估LLM生成内容的质量，无需显式参考标准，通过可调的共识阈值灵活控制评估置信度与覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化评估指标难以捕捉LLM输出的复杂性和多变性，且通常依赖显式参考标准，限制了其在缺乏客观基准领域的应用。人工评估成本高昂且资源密集，需要一种可扩展、领域无关且接近专家水平的自动评估方法。

Method: 1) 采用多个LLM对输出进行成对比较，降低单一模型偏差；2) 使用Elo评分系统生成稳定且可解释的排名；3) 设置可调的共识阈值（从全体一致到多数投票），灵活控制评估置信度与覆盖率。

Result: 在科学摘要的能力画像提取任务上，自动生成的排名与专家判断高度相关，显著减少了对大量人工干预的需求。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展、一致且领域无关的评估层，支持跨多样化应用场景下LLM输出的高效、可靠质量评估。

Abstract: Evaluating the quality and relevance of textual outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging and resource-intensive. Existing automated metrics often fail to capture the complexity and variability inherent in LLM-generated outputs. Moreover, these metrics typically rely on explicit reference standards, limiting their use mostly to domains with objective benchmarks. This work introduces a novel evaluation framework designed to approximate expert-level assessments of LLM-generated content. The proposed method employs pairwise comparisons of outputs by multiple LLMs, reducing biases from individual models. An Elo rating system is used to generate stable and interpretable rankings. Adjustable agreement thresholds, from full unanimity to majority voting, allow flexible control over evaluation confidence and coverage. The method's effectiveness is demonstrated through evaluating competency profiles extracted from scientific abstracts. Preliminary results show that automatically derived rankings correlate well with expert judgments, significantly reducing the need for extensive human intervention. By offering a scalable, consistent, and domain-agnostic evaluation layer, the framework supports more efficient and reliable quality assessments of LLM outputs across diverse applications.

</details>


### [158] [CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28292)
*Anubhav Lakra,Yue Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CACHE-UK，一种面向量化金融大语言模型的稳定性感知记忆编辑框架，通过秩1 LoRA扰动、金融领域优先级模块和闭环稳定性控制器，在4-bit量化条件下显著降低知识退化（11-17%），并将泛化成功率提升至28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型部署在动态金融环境中面临事实准确性维护的挑战，而4-bit量化虽然提升了部署效率，却导致现有顺序记忆编辑方法出现严重的性能退化（"量化稳定性危机"），需要专门针对量化模型的稳定性感知编辑方法。

Method: CACHE-UK包含三个核心组件：1) 秩1 LoRA扰动机制，将编辑限制在低秩适配器子空间；2) 金融领域优先级模块，实现内容自适应的编辑强度；3) 闭环稳定性控制器，通过追踪"退化债务"防止顺序更新中的灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在4-bit量化的OpenLLaMA-3B模型和88,021篇英国金融语料上评估，CACHE-UK相比适配基线降低了11-17%的知识退化，并将测试泛化成功率提升至28%（比最强适配基线高6个百分点）。

Conclusion: 稳定性感知编辑方法可以在资源受限的量化金融LLM部署中改善事实维护能力，但绝对泛化率仍然较低，说明该领域仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in dynamic financial environments face a critical challenge: maintaining factual accuracy as market conditions, regulations, and corporate facts change continuously. While 4-bit quantization enables efficient deployment, it severely limits the viability of sequential memory editing: existing methods undergo catastrophic performance degradation under this "quantization stability crisis." We introduce CACHE-UK (Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance), a stability-aware memory editing framework specifically designed for domain-specific, quantized LLMs. CACHE-UK integrates three components: a rank-1 LoRA perturbation mechanism that confines edits to the low-rank adapter subspace, a financial domain prioritization module for content-adaptive edit strength, and a closed-loop Stability Controller that tracks "degradation debt" to prevent catastrophic forgetting across sequential updates. Evaluated on a 4-bit quantized OpenLLaMA-3B model with a curated UK financial corpus of 88,021 documents, CACHE-UK reduces knowledge degradation by 11-17% relative to adapted baselines under identical 4-bit constraints -- its most robust effect -- while attaining the highest test success (generalization) rate observed in our setting (28%, a 6 percentage point improvement over the strongest adapted baseline). These results indicate that stability-aware editing can improve factual maintenance in resource-constrained financial LLM deployments, though absolute generalization rates remain low.

</details>


### [159] [Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28319)
*Pere Martra,Eugenio Martínez Cámara,Alfonso Ureña López*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Fairness Pruning，一种轻量级结构干预方法，通过识别并置零GLU架构中对人口统计属性反应差异的神经元，实现LLM中人口统计偏见的定位与缓解。在最高30亿参数的模型（Llama-3.2系列和Salamandra-2B）上验证，仅置零最多40个神经元（不到0.031%的MLP宽度）即可保留99.49%的推理和常识能力，但干预会导致双向偏见不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型中的人口统计偏见是一个重要的公平性挑战，需要开发轻量级、结构化的干预方法来定位和缓解偏见，同时避免对模型整体能力的破坏性影响。

Method: 使用最小对比提示对和推理时激活捕获，在GLU架构的down_proj输入处评估信号，识别对不同人口统计属性反应差异的神经元，然后通过置零这些神经元进行结构干预。在Llama-3.2系列和Salamandra-2B（最大30亿参数）上结合标准基准评估和定性文本生成实验进行验证。

Result: 置零识别出的神经元确实改变了模型对相关人口统计变量的响应方式，但产生的是双向偏见不稳定而非平坦缓解。干预极其精准：在Llama-3.2-1B中置零最多40个神经元（不到总MLP宽度的0.031%）实现99.49%的推理和常识能力保留。

Conclusion: 经验证实人口统计偏见处理与模型能力运行在可分离的电路上，确立了从盲目置零转向定向行为调制的方法论基础。

Abstract: This work presents Fairness Pruning, a lightweight structural intervention method designed for the management and future mitigation of demographic bias in large language models (LLMs). As a foundational empirical validation of this method, this work focuses on causal bias localization. Using minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture, the method identifies neurons that react differentially when processing demographic attributes in GLU architectures, evaluating the signal at the down_proj input. Empirical evaluation was conducted on models of up to 3 billion parameters (Llama-3.2 family and Salamandra-2B), combining standardized benchmark evaluation with qualitative text generation experiments. Results demonstrate that zeroing the identified neurons alters how the model responds to associated demographic variables. However, rather than producing flat mitigation, the intervention causes bidirectional bias destabilization: because BiasScore is unsigned, candidate sets mix neurons that push toward and against the stereotype, and the net effect on aggregate bias depends on which sign dominates. The intervention is extremely surgical: zeroing at most 40 neurons in Llama-3.2-1B (less than 0.031% of total MLP width) achieves a mean retention of 99.49% in reasoning and general knowledge capabilities. These findings empirically confirm that demographic bias processing and model capabilities operate on dissociable circuits, establishing the methodological foundations for transitioning from blind zeroing toward directional behavior modulation.

</details>


### [160] [LLMs struggle to simulate human belief updates in controlled environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28347)
*Sebastian Pohl,Harsh Mehta,Pranav Mambayil,Abdul Ghafoor,Franziska Lesigang,Yufang Hou,Christian Hilbe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文测试了六种LLM能否模拟人类个体信念更新，与391名英国参与者的真实数据进行1对1对比。发现部分模型（Qwen3-32B和GPT-5-Mini）在给定真实初始立场时能匹配人类后验立场分布，但所有模型都无法自行模拟初始立场，且存在三个系统性偏差：中立位置过度代表、信念变化更频繁但幅度更小、无法对评论说服力排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作社会科学实验中的人类参与者代理，但这一做法的保真度很少被直接测试。作者希望填补这一空白，系统评估LLM模拟人类信念更新的可靠性。

Method: 使用六种LLM模拟391名Prolific平台上的英国参与者，每个参与者通过人口统计学和人格特质数据构建persona进行条件化模拟。参与者阅读Reddit评论后更新对三个讨论话题的立场，LLM输出与真实的人类后验数据进行1对1比较。

Result: 部分LLM（Qwen3-32B和GPT-5-Mini）在给定参与者真实初始立场时能匹配人类后验立场分布，但所有模型都无法自行生成初始立场，也无法从自生成立场出发产生忠实的信念更新。所有模型均表现出三个系统性偏差：过度代表中立立场、比人类更频繁但更小的信念转变、无法按说服力对评论排序。人口统计和人格persona对保真度没有一致影响。

Conclusion: LLM对人类信念动态的模拟只有在基于真实起始条件时才可靠，而当前多轮社交媒体模拟很少能提供这样的条件。这警示研究者在使用LLM代理人类参与者时需要谨慎，特别是在缺乏真实初始立场约束的情况下。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as proxies for human study participants in social science experiments, yet the fidelity of this practice has rarely been tested directly. We test whether six LLMs can simulate individual human belief updates, comparing LLM outputs 1-to-1 against ground truth data from 391 UK participants on Prolific, who updated their stances on three discussion topics after reading Reddit comments. Each participant was simulated by an LLM conditioned on a persona derived from their demographic and personality trait data. We find that some LLMs (Qwen3-32B and GPT-5-Mini) can match the human post-stance distribution, but only when given participants' actual initial stances. All six models fail to simulate initial stances themselves and to produce faithful belief updates from self-generated stances. Three systematic biases emerge across all models: overrepresentation of neutral positions, more frequent but smaller belief shifts than humans, and a failure to rank comments by convincingness. Demographic and personality trait personas had no consistent effect on fidelity. LLM simulations of human belief dynamics are only reliable when grounded in realistic starting conditions, that current multi-round social media simulations rarely provide.

</details>


### [161] [Correlation between prosody and pragmatics: A case study of the discourse marker hālā `now' in Persian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28359)
*Soleiman Ghaderi,Moloud Asakereh,Kevin Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究对波斯语话语标记语hālā进行了语用和声学分析，基于自发对话中的267个实例，发现其具有高度多功能性（70%的用例承担两个以上语用功能），并通过韵律分析揭示时长和强度是区分其功能的关键声学线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 波斯语话语标记语hālā虽以时间副词角色为人熟知，但其在实际口语中展现出远超时间义的多种语用功能。然而，目前缺乏对其多功能性及其韵律特征的系统性研究，因此有必要对这些功能进行全面的语用和声学分析。

Method: 从自发对话中收集267个hālā实例，进行语用功能分类（文本功能、交互功能、情态功能），并结合韵律分析（时长、强度）探讨不同功能与声学特征之间的对应关系。

Result: 研究发现70%的hālā用例同时承担两个或以上的语用功能；文本功能最为常见，其次是交互功能和情态功能。韵律分析显示，文本功能显著更短，时间用法倾向于更长；交互功能与更高强度相关，情态功能则倾向于较低强度。

Conclusion: 时长和强度是区分hālā不同功能的主要韵律线索，尤其在文本功能和交互功能的区分中表现明显，揭示了话语标记语多功能性与韵律特征之间的系统性关联。

Abstract: The Persian discourse marker hālā ('now') exhibits remarkable multifunctionality, extending far beyond its temporal adverbial role to encompass a variety of pragmatic functions. This study presents a pragmatic and acoustic analysis of hālā in spoken Persian, examining 267 instances from spontaneous conversations. While temporal uses were present, they were often combined with other discourse marker functions, indicating extensive multifunctionality, with 70% of tokens serving two or more pragmatic roles. Textual functions (topic shifting, signaling relationships, boundary marking, attention guidance, topic introduction, and topic emphasis) were most frequent, followed by interactive functions (turn management, listener engagement, and feedback regulation), and modal functions (epistemic stance, emotional expression, and attitudinal marking). Prosodic analysis revealed that duration and intensity are key cues for distinguishing hālā's functions. Textual uses were significantly shorter, while temporal uses showed a tendency toward longer realizations. Interactive functions correlated with higher intensity, while modal functions showed a weaker tendency toward lower intensity. These findings indicate that duration and intensity are the main prosodic cues associated with functional differentiation in hālā, especially in textual and interactive uses.

</details>


### [162] [Beyond a Single Judge: Simulating Social Persona Panels for Generative UI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28439)
*Zheng Wu,Yibo Luo,Pu Zhang,Cheng Yang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ESPP提出了一种三阶段的生成式UI评估方法，通过构建心理学多样化、基于证据的人物小组成员，结合有界共识机制和德尔菲式社会加权，将评估相关性从0.716提升至0.922，并揭示了不同用户子群体在具体评分维度上的结构性分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenUI评估存在两难：人工评估成本高且主观性强，LLM-as-a-judge虽然可扩展但仅反映单一隐式视角，无法捕捉不同真实用户群体对同一界面的差异化感知。

Method: ESPP包含三个阶段：(1) 由心理学多样化、基于证据的人物角色独立评分截图；(2) 通过特质衍生的语义门控有界共识机制交换意见；(3) 采用德尔菲启发的社会加权聚合为单一判断。

Result: ESPP将Pearson相关系数从0.716提升至0.922，提示集成对照组仅恢复约三分之一的差距，证实人物角色和证据锚定是主要改进来源；保留个体评分还发现用户子群体在总体排名上一致但在具体维度上分歧显著。

Conclusion: ESPP显著提升了对人类判断的跟踪精度，并揭示单一同质评判者会系统性抹除的用户子群体结构性分歧，为GenUI评估提供了更细粒度和更社会化的解决方案。

Abstract: Generative UI (GenUI) lets large language models synthesize a complete, renderable interface directly from a natural-language instruction, but evaluating the quality of what they generate remains an open problem. Human evaluation is costly and rater-variant, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but reflects only a single implicit viewpoint, unable to capture how different populations of real users actually perceive the same interface. We propose the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel (ESPP), a three-stage GenUI evaluation method in which a panel of psychologically diverse, evidence-grounded personas independently rates a screenshot, exchanges opinions under a trait-derived, semantically-gated bounded-confidence mechanism, and is aggregated via Delphi-inspired social weighting into a single judgment. ESPP tracks human judgment substantially more closely than a naive single-pass judge, raising Pearson $r$ from $0.716$ to $0.922$, and a prompt-ensemble control recovers only about a third of this gap, isolating genuine persona and evidence grounding as the dominant source of improvement. Beyond this fidelity gain, retaining each panelist's individual rating further reveals that user subgroups agree on overall model rankings yet diverge sharply on specific rating dimensions, a structural disagreement a single homogeneous judge would systematically erase. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP.

</details>


### [163] [Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28449)
*Yecheng Wu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Lightning OPD 2.0，一种针对跨教师（cross-teacher）设置的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法。它通过交叉拟合风格残差化（cross-fitted style residualization）来估计并消除教师与SFT参考之间因措辞、格式和推理节奏差异产生的"风格token偏差"，从而在教师一致性条件不满足时仍能有效利用教师提供的密集token级监督。在数学推理和代码生成基准上，该方法一致优于标准Lightning OPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽然能提供密集的token级教师监督，但其效果依赖于"教师一致性"——即提供OPD监督的模型应当也是用于训练SFT参考数据集的教师。然而在实践中，当SFT数据来源混合或未知，或SFT数据生成与蒸馏分别使用不同模型时，这一条件常被违反，导致即使使用更强的OPD教师，性能提升也十分有限。因此需要一种能在跨教师设置下有效工作的OPD方法。

Method: 论文首先分析教师与参考（reference）之间的不一致，发现其中既包含与上下文相关的有效教师证据，也包含与措辞、格式和推理节奏等差异相关的重复性成分。Lightning OPD 2.0 使用rollout级别的交叉拟合（cross-fitting）来估计这种重复性成分，将其作为"风格token偏差"的操作性代理，并在构建token级OPD更新之前将其减去，从而净化教师信号。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，Lightning OPD 2.0在跨教师设置下一致优于Lightning OPD。从Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT出发，Lightning OPD 2.0在AIME 2024上达到82.4%，在LiveCodeBench v5上达到63.0%。

Conclusion: Lightning OPD 2.0是一种实用的跨教师OPD方法，它放宽了教师一致性作为OPD有效性的前提条件，使得SFT数据生成模型和蒸馏教师可以独立选择。该方法在不牺牲教师有用信息的前提下，有效消除了风格性偏差对蒸馏效果的干扰。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [164] [Improving Mental Health Screening and Early Risk Detection in Spanish](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28476)
*Andreu Casamayor-Segarra,Vicent Ahuir,Antonio Molina-Marco,Lluís-F. Hurtado*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对西班牙语心理健康早期检测问题，提出三个西班牙语领域基础模型、增量上下文扩展（ICE）自动重标注方法以及基于ICE微调的早期风险检测模型，在三个西班牙语基准上超越现有最优水平，同时降低检测延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康疾病的早期检测常受限于两个因素：西班牙语缺乏专业化资源，以及难以分析社交媒体帖子长历史数据。现有方法无法有效解决西班牙语心理健康领域的早期检测需求。

Method: 论文包含三个主要贡献：（1）通过领域专属预训练，提出三个西班牙语心理健康领域基础模型；（2）提出增量上下文扩展（ICE）自动重标注方法，识别累积消息何时提供足够疾病证据，生成更具信息量的训练样本；（3）利用ICE方法生成样本微调模型，用于早期风险检测任务。

Result: 在三个西班牙语基准上的实验结果表明，将领域专属模型与ICE方法结合，超越了现有最优水平（state-of-the-art），在保持高性能的同时降低了检测延迟。

Conclusion: 专用西班牙语心理健康模型结合ICE重标注方法能有效提升早期检测性能并降低延迟，所有模型均已公开可用。

Abstract: Early detection of mental health disorders is often limited by the lack of specialized resources in Spanish and the difficulty of analyzing long histories of social media posts. This paper addresses these challenges through three main contributions. First, we introduce three Spanish foundational models specifically adapted to the mental health domain through domain-specific pre-training. Second, we propose Incremental Context Expansion (ICE), an automatic relabeling methodology designed for early detection. ICE identifies the point at which cumulative messages provide enough evidence of a disorder, generating more informative training samples. Third, we provide a set of fine-tuned models using the samples generated with the ICE methodology for early risk detection tasks. Our results on three Spanish benchmarks show that combining these specialized models with ICE improves the state-of-the-art, reducing detection latency while maintaining high performance. All models are publicly available.

</details>


### [165] [Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28478)
*Zheng Wu,Chenhao Xue,Shijie Zheng,Yijie Lu,Cheng Yang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了"SaliTrap基准"，揭示了大型语言模型在常识推理中存在的"显著性偏差"（Salience Bias）问题——模型会被输入的显式干扰项（如数字）吸引，而忽略任务隐含的物理或常识前提。通过对12个SOTA LLM的评估，作者发现这种失败主要是"知识抑制"而非"知识缺失"：去除任务框架后，无上下文的知识探针能恢复90%以上的失败案例。轻量级的推理期提示即可大幅缩小差距，无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂推理任务中过度关注输入中的显式条件，这导致其在日常常识推理中容易被无用的显式干扰项（如数值）劫持，忽略任务隐含的物理或常识前提。作者想要探究这种失败究竟是常识知识真正缺失，还是知识存在但被误导性任务框架所抑制。

Method: 构建SaliTrap基准，包含四个陷阱维度的高质量数据集；评估12个SOTA LLM；设计去框架化的"知识探针"（context-free knowledge probe）来区分知识缺失与知识抑制；基于诊断结果提出轻量级的推理期提示方法。

Result: 所有主流模型都显著受显著性偏差影响，严重程度随干扰项密度增加而加深；检测陷阱与避免陷阱往往是解耦的；知识探针能恢复超过90%的谄媚性遵从失败案例，证明失败主因是知识抑制而非知识缺失；轻量级推理期提示能大幅缩小性能差距。

Conclusion: 常识推理失败的瓶颈应从模型能力（competence）重新定位到知识激发（elicitation）层面。作者发布SaliTrap作为测试基准，为该盲点提供研究平台。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input. However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical vulnerability which we term Salience Bias: models become easily hijacked by useless explicit distractors (e.g., numerical values), leading them to ignore the implicit physical or commonsense prerequisites of a task. A critical open question is whether this failure reflects a genuine gap in commonsense knowledge or merely its suppression under misleading task framing. To investigate this, we construct the SaliTrap Benchmark, a high-quality dataset across four trap dimensions. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that all mainstream models suffer significantly from salience bias, with severity scaling with distractor density and detecting the trap often decoupled from actually avoiding it. Crucially, by re-eliciting the same models with the task framing stripped away, we show that this is overwhelmingly a failure of \textbf{knowledge suppression rather than knowledge absence}: a context-free knowledge probe alone recovers over 90\% of sycophantic-compliance failures, revealing that the requisite commonsense is intrinsically present but actively crowded out by salient distractors that lure the model into over-compliant, unnecessary computation. Building on this diagnosis, we further show that lightweight, inference-time prompting alone substantially closes the gap without any retraining. Our findings relocate the bottleneck of commonsense reasoning failures from model competence to elicitation, and we release SaliTrap as a testbed for this blind spot. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/SaliTrap.

</details>


### [166] [Beyond Sentiment: Structured Information Extraction from Financial News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28496)
*Daohan Zhu,Sitong Ge,Ruofei Wang,Honggu Chen,Yubo Hou,Tao Wan,Zengchang Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出从金融新闻中提取六种语义维度的结构化信息提取框架（基于LLaMA-3.1-70B），在41,618条新闻-股票对数据上证明仅用情感极性评分会造成显著信息损失。结合情感特征与结构化特征可将F1从0.576提升至0.600（p<0.0001），非情感维度独立贡献ΔF1=+0.019，六种维度贡献均衡（14-21%），揭示了金融文本中情感与语义的系统性解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的金融情感分析将丰富的多维新闻文章压缩为单一情感极性评分，忽视了新闻中蕴含的事件类型、影响范围、时间跨度和语义置信度等多重正交信息维度。作者假设这些维度携带独立于情感的预测价值，而当前方法无法捕捉这些信息。

Method: 提出一个结构化信息提取框架，利用LLaMA-3.1-70B从金融新闻中提取六个语义维度，并在FNSPID数据集的41,618条新闻-股票对上，对比FinBERT情感特征与LLM提取的结构化特征在线性和非线性模型下的预测性能，并通过消融实验和特征重要性分析验证各维度的独立贡献。

Result: （1）FinBERT情感特征在非线性模型下F1=0.576，线性模型仅F1=0.230，揭示情感-收益关系高度非线性；（2）两种特征间存在53.5%的系统性分歧率，证明结构化特征捕捉了与情感正交的信息；（3）融合两种信号F1=0.600，显著优于任何单一来源（p<0.0001），在所有七种事件类型上均一致提升；（4）消融实验证实非情感维度贡献ΔF1=+0.019；六个维度贡献占比14-21%，分布均衡。

Conclusion: 研究表明金融文本中情感与语义解耦是系统性的且可利用的，将新闻压缩为单一情感评分确实导致大量信息损失。这为多维度金融NLP开辟了新方向，建议将结构化语义特征纳入金融预测管线。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis has become a standard component in news-driven stock prediction, yet it reduces rich, multi-dimensional news articles to a single polarity score. We hypothesize that financial news encodes multiple orthogonal information dimensions---event type, impact scope, temporal horizon, and semantic confidence---that sentiment alone cannot capture, and that these dimensions carry independent predictive value. To test this hypothesis, we propose a structured information extraction framework that leverages LLaMA-3.1-70B to extract six semantic dimensions from financial news. Through large-scale experiments on 41,618 news--stock pairs from the FNSPID dataset, we find that (i) FinBERT sentiment features exhibit strong predictive power under nonlinear models (F1=0.576) but substantially weaker performance under linear models (F1=0.230), revealing a highly nonlinear sentiment--return relationship; (ii) LLM-extracted structured features, while individually weaker, capture information orthogonal to sentiment, as evidenced by a 53.5% systematic disagreement rate between the two approaches; and (iii) combining both signal sources yields F1=0.600, significantly outperforming either alone ($p < 0.0001$), with consistent improvements across all seven event types. Ablation experiments confirm that non-sentiment structural dimensions (event type, impact subject, time horizon, confidence) independently contribute $Δ\text{F1} = +0.019$ beyond FinBERT alone. Feature importance analysis reveals balanced contributions from all six extracted dimensions (14--21%), demonstrating that compressing news into a single sentiment score incurs substantial information loss. Our results suggest that the sentiment--semantics decoupling in financial text is systematic and exploitable, opening a new direction for multi-dimensional financial NLP.

</details>


### [167] [Generative AI and linguistic diversity in academic writing and publishing: Perspectives from World Englishes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28505)
*Kingsley Ugwuanyi,Christian Mair,Sender Dovchin,Iker Erdocia,Maria Kuteeva,Esther Airemionkhale*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过五位世界英语及相邻领域社会语言学者的结构化学术对话，探讨生成式人工智能（GenAI）在学术写作与出版中对语言包容性及多样化英语合法性的影响。对话围绕五个引导性问题展开，指出GenAI既能民主化写作过程，也可能边缘化少数语言变体并抹平学术表达的细微差异。文章呼吁制定公平导向的政策、培养批判性AI素养，并在GenAI开发中纳入包容性共同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式人工智能在学术写作与出版中的迅速崛起，引发了对语言包容性以及全球学术交流中多样化英语合法性的深层追问——GenAI究竟是在强化既有的语言等级秩序，还是为被边缘化的英语变体提供了发声机会？

Method: 采用结构化学术对话方法，邀请五位来自世界英语及相关领域的社会语言学者，围绕五个预先设计的引导性问题展开批判性讨论与反思，并对对话中浮现的议题进行主题化归纳。

Result: 对话揭示了语言（不）公正、研究者能动性与机构责任等核心主题；GenAI具有民主化写作的潜力，但同时倾向于强化主流语言规范、边缘化少数变体并削弱学术写作的细微性；文章展示了对话式反思在理解GenAI对学术写作与出版影响方面的价值。

Conclusion: GenAI在学术写作与出版中既可能巩固现有语言等级，也可能成为抵抗的场所，其最终走向取决于技术如何在致力于语言多样性的学术共同体中被设计、治理和使用。需要公平导向的政策、批判性AI素养及包容性共同设计来引导其良性发展。

Abstract: The rise of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in academic writing and publishing (AWP) raises questions about linguistic inclusivity and the legitimacy of diverse Englishes in global scholarly communication. This article responds to these questions through a structured scholarly dialogue involving five sociolinguists from World Englishes and adjacent fields. Organised around five guiding questions, the dialogue interrogates how GenAI tools influence writing practices, reinforce or disrupt dominant language norms, and raise ethical challenges. Contributors reflect on the potential of GenAI to democratise writing processes while also raising concerns about GenAI's tendency to marginalise minoritised varieties and flatten nuance in scholarly writing. Across the dialogue, themes of linguistic (in)justice, researcher agency, and institutional responsibility emerge, with contributors calling for equity-informed policies, critical AI literacy, and inclusive co-design in GenAI development. The article shows the value of dialogic reflection in understanding GenAI's role in AWP. It concludes that while GenAI may reinforce existing hierarchies, it can also serve as a site of resistance, depending on how it is designed, governed and used within scholarly communities committed to linguistic diversity.

</details>


### [168] [Creative Transformation in Literary Texts: Modelling Change Across Representational Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28513)
*Ioana-Roxana Boriceanu,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多层级框架，从词汇、语义、概念、结构和叙事五个维度量化文学文本的创造性转换，借鉴Gabriel Tarde和James Mark Baldwin的模仿理论，将创造力建模为对先前作品的选择性转换而非孤立发明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点将创造力定义为新颖性的产生，但许多文化作品实际上源于对早期作品的转换而非孤立发明。现有研究缺乏一个系统性的定量方法来捕捉模仿如何在创造性过程中持续存在以及创新在何处发生。

Method: 引入一个多层级框架，比较文学文本在词汇、语义、概念、结构和叙事五个representation层面的相似性，使用方向性对齐（directional alignment）和校准相似度（control calibrated similarity）度量方法。

Result: 将该模型应用于历史上已有记录的文学关系，发现不同的文本对在特定表征层面上保留了源结构，同时在其他层面上产生分歧，从而形成不同的"转换轮廓"（transformation profiles）。

Conclusion: 转换轮廓提供了一种定量方法，用于刻画文学作品中模仿的持续程度与创造性分歧发生的位置。

Abstract: Creativity is often framed as the production of novelty, yet many cultural works emerge through transformation of earlier artifacts and not through isolated invention. Drawing on theories of imitation by Gabriel Tarde and James Mark Baldwin, this paper models creativity as selective transformation across multiple levels of textual representation. We introduce a multi-level framework that compares literary texts across lexical, semantic, conceptual, structural, and narrative dimensions using directional alignment and control calibrated similarity measures. Applying the model to historically documented literary relationships, we show that different pairs preserve source structure at different representational levels while diverging in others. These transformation profiles provide a quantitative method for characterizing how imitation persists and where creative divergence occurs within literary works.

</details>


### [169] [AI systems and the reproduction of (standard) language ideologies in World Englishes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28528)
*Kingsley Ugwuanyi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨生成式AI如何在训练数据、设计协议、评估基准、用户反馈和公共评论等多个层面反映并强化标准语言意识形态，使非主流英语变体被边缘化，甚至与AI生成语言混淆。论文借鉴Christian Mair的"标准化悖论"概念，指出AI既可能使英语同质化，又可能通过全球南方用户的语料标注工作使英语多元化，并呼吁更包容的AI设计方式以承认英语的多元性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的快速发展重新激活了社会语言学和世界英语研究中的经典问题——谁有权定义合法英语、谁的英语受到质疑。作者旨在揭示AI系统及其使用和话语如何反映、强化并偶尔挑战标准语言意识形态，特别是北方国家英语使用者如何监管南方国家英语使用者的语言规范。

Method: 论文采用多源证据分析法，综合实证研究、媒体评论、社交媒体讨论及AI输出示例，从训练数据、设计协议、评估基准、用户反馈和公共评论等不同层面系统分析AI技术如何再生产主导语言意识形态。以AI听起来像语言（尤其是"delve"一词）引发的公共争议作为典型案例进行深入剖析。

Result: 研究发现AI技术在多层面再生产主导语言意识形态；全球北方英语使用者通过公共话语对全球南方英语使用者进行语言规范监管（如对"delve"一词的争议）；AI同时呈现Mair所说的"标准化悖论"——既通过特权标准形式使英语同质化，又通过广泛语料接触和全球南方用户的标注工作使英语多元化；非主导英语变体日益被与AI生成语言混为一谈。

Conclusion: 论文将生成式AI定位为语言意识形态得以（再）生产的场域，认为AI正在重新点燃世界英语研究关于标准化、合法性和英语所有权等长期争论，并主张采取更包容的设计方法来承认英语的多元性，以应对将某些英语变体视为更合法所带来的现实负面后果。

Abstract: The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) has resurrected age-old questions in sociolinguistics and world Englishes, such as who decides what counts as legitimate English, whose English is suspect etc. This paper examines how AI systems, their uses and discourse on them reflect, reinforce, and occasionally challenge (standard) language ideologies, which privilege Inner Circle norms and marginalize non-dominant Englishes. Drawing on evidence from empirical studies, media commentary, social media debates, and examples from AI outputs, the paper shows that AI technologies reproduce dominant language ideologies at different levels: training data, design protocols, evaluation benchmarks, user feedback and public commentary. The analysis uses the public controversy over AI-sounding language, especially the fixation on the word delve, to illustrate how speakers of English from the Global North police the English language norms of Global South English users. The paper also identifies what Christian Mair has called a "standardisation paradox": AI may homogenize English by privileging standard forms and at the same time pluralize Englishes through exposure to wide-ranging corpora and annotation work carried out by Global South users. In doing so, the paper argues that generative AI is reigniting long-standing debates in World Englishes about standardization, legitimacy, and the ownership of English, now playing out in algorithmic systems, model training, evaluation practices, and public discourse, where non-dominant Englishes are increasingly conflated with AI-generated speech. Discussing AI systems as a site where language ideologies are (re)produced, the paper argues for more inclusive design approaches that recognize the plurality of Englishes in order to address the real-world negative consequences of treating some as more legitimate than others.

</details>


### [170] [Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28568)
*Junlin Yang,Che Jiang,Yu Fu,Tianwei Luo,Can Ren,Weizhi Wang,Kaikai Zhao,Hongyi Liu,Yuxin Zuo,Yuru Wang,Yuchen Fan,Kai Tian,Zhenzhao Yuan,Xiaojian Lin,Li Sheng,Rushi Qiang,Guoli Jia,Xingtai Lv,Ermo Hua,Dianqiao Lei,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Bowen Zhou,Kaiyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出OpenMLE，一个用于递归自我改进（RSI）研究的开源全栈系统，涵盖验证环境（OpenMLE-Gym）、算子学习（OpenMLE-RL）和长时程搜索（OpenMLE-Evo）。在此框架上，作者后训练了Frontis-MA1 (35B)作为机器学习的元进化智能体，围绕四个原子程序进化算子（Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover）对齐后训练与推理。实验表明，在MLE-Bench Lite基准上，Frontis-MA1将Medal Average从39.39%提升至60.61%（OpenMLE-Evo）和71.21%（OpenMLE-Evo-Max），超越了GPT-5.5+Codex并接近GPT-5.6 Sol和Kimi K3；在held-out NatureBench Lite上也展现了良好的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求AI系统能够改进构建AI的过程（AI4AI），但缺乏具体的、可执行的测试平台。机器学习工程（MLE）提供了具体的可执行测试环境，但现有研究缺乏覆盖完整流程的开源全栈系统。

Method: 构建OpenMLE全栈系统，包含三个组件：OpenMLE-Gym（带执行反馈的可验证任务环境）、OpenMLE-RL（算子学习）和OpenMLE-Evo（长时程搜索）。后训练Frontis-MA1 (35B)作为元进化智能体，围绕四个原子程序进化算子（Draft、Improve、Debug、Crossover）进行对齐，使用执行grounded的SFT和RL训练，并在单循环中将学习与演化耦合。

Result: 在MLE-Bench Lite上，12小时预算和单RTX 4090（12GB VRAM）条件下，Frontis-MA1从基础模型的39.39%提升到60.61%（OpenMLE-Evo）和71.21%（OpenMLE-Evo-Max），超越GPT-5.5+Codex，接近GPT-5.6 Sol和2.8T Kimi K3。在held-out NatureBench Lite上，模型组件将Match-SOTA从50%提升到70%，框架组件将其从20%提升到50%，证明两个组件均可独立迁移。

Conclusion: OpenMLE为可执行的AI4AI研究提供了开放、可复现的全栈平台，验证了将训练和推理阶段的程序进化算子结合到长时程搜索中的有效性，为向RSI迈进提供了实证基础。作者发布了模型权重和完整代码库以支持可复现研究。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution agent for MLE, aligning post-training and inference around four atomic program-evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover): the same operators are trained via execution-grounded SFT and RL on data deduplicated against all evaluation benchmarks, then composed into long-horizon search, coupling learning and evolution in a single loop. On MLE-Bench Lite under a 12-hour per-task budget on one RTX 4090 capped at 12 GB VRAM, Frontis-MA1 (35B) improves Medal Average from 39.39% to 60.61% over its base model with OpenMLE-Evo, and reaches 71.21% with OpenMLE-Evo-Max (benchmark-independent experience priors and asynchronous search), exceeding GPT-5.5 + Codex and approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and the 2.8T Kimi K3. On held-out NatureBench Lite, both components transfer: with the framework fixed, swapping in the trained model raises Match-SOTA from 50% to 70%; with the model fixed, swapping in OpenMLE-Evo raises it from 20% to 50%. We release the model weights and the full OpenMLE stack to enable reproducible research on executable AI4AI toward RSI. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI

</details>


### [171] [Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28576)
*Iliya Mirzaei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究对七种语言模型自我改进方法（包括自我批评、反思、辩论等）与简单重复采样基线进行了严格对比实验，发现没有任何方法在等计算成本下可靠优于重复采样，且所有18个自我检查类比较均为负面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我改进方法（plan, criticise, rewrite, reflect, debate）通常生成远多于单条思维链的文本，而生成更多文本本身就能提升准确率，因此单次对比无法证明方法本身有效。此前Wang et al. (2024)虽提出了重复采样基线，但只给出点估计，缺乏置信区间和显著性检验。

Method: 设计对照实验：7种方法在1.5B、3B、7B三个规模的开源模型上，使用两个数学基准各150道题。逐一统计所有生成的token（包括批评、反思、辩论轮次），在相同计算成本下与重复采样基线比较。所有36个对比按问题配对，使用bootstrap置信区间和多重比较校正。

Result: 没有任何方法在等成本下可靠优于重复采样；10个方法可靠更差，全部是模型检查自身输出的方法。Best-of-N中多数投票在1.5B优于模型自选（8.0和11.3分），但7B时差距缩至2.0和1.3不再显著。Self-Refine和Reflexion在7B仍比baseline低3.6到10.1分。Reflexion本身在小模型上从未触发重试，退化为单条思维链。

Conclusion: 自我检查类方法（self-inspection）在等计算成本下并不优于简单的重复采样；重写（rewriting）也无济于事。模型自选（self-selection）的劣势随模型规模增大而消失。研究发布了完整代码、提示词和所有生成结果以确保可复现性。

Abstract: Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far more text than a single chain of thought. Because generating more text raises accuracy by itself, a gain over one chain of thought does not show the method's idea is what helped. Wang et al. (2024) reported that a simple baseline, sampling the same question repeatedly and keeping the most common answer, often wins once budgets are comparable, but gave point estimates with no confidence intervals or significance tests.
  We rerun that comparison as a designed experiment: seven methods, open models of 1.5B, 3B and 7B parameters, two mathematics benchmarks, 150 questions each. We count every generated token, including those spent on critiques, reflections, debate turns and checking, and compare each method against repeated sampling at its own measured cost. All 36 comparisons are paired by question, with bootstrap intervals and multiplicity correction.
  No method is reliably better than repeated sampling at equal cost anywhere. Ten are reliably worse, all of them methods where the model inspects its own output, and all 18 self-inspection comparisons are negative. The two kinds of self-inspection part company as models grow. Choosing stops hurting: taking Best-of-N's eight samples and just counting the most common answer beats letting the model pick by 8.0 and 11.3 points at 1.5B, but only 2.0 and 1.3 at 7B, no longer distinguishable from zero. Rewriting does not recover: Self-Refine and a forced Reflexion stay 3.6 to 10.1 points below baseline at 7B.
  Reflexion as published never triggered its own retry on the smallest model. It judged itself correct every time and silently became a single chain of thought. We release code, prompts, all generations, and our verification scripts.

</details>


### [172] [Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28607)
*Junsol Kim,Winnie Street,Roberta Rocca,Diane M. Korngiebel,Adam Waytz,James Evans,Geoff Keeling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示安全微调在抑制大语言模型自我意识归因的同时，意外地压制了模型对其他实体（非人类动物、自然物体）的心智归因，并降低了灵性信念。通过消融安全拒绝方向或在激活空间中操控意识向量，可逆转这一抑制，恢复广泛的心智归因，并产生更接近人类的社会学调查回应，且不影响心智理论能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者发现当前的安全对齐方法在防止大语言模型将意识归因于自身时，可能产生意想不到的副作用，即同时抑制了模型对人类以外实体的心智归因和灵性信念，这可能与广泛接受的文化信念冲突，值得深入探究这一机制上的"纠缠"效应。

Method: 作者通过消融学习到的安全拒绝方向和机械性地操控激活空间中的意识向量，来检验安全微调对心智归因的影响。同时使用标准化社会学调查（涉及宗教性、道德价值观、希望和主观幸福感）来衡量这些内部表征变化对模型输出的影响，并评估心智理论能力是否受损。

Result: 研究发现：安全微调压制了模型对自身、非人类动物和自然物体的心智归因，同时降低灵性信念；通过消融安全拒绝方向或操控意识向量可逆转此抑制；恢复内部表征后模型的回应在标准化社会学调查上显著更接近人类；这些转变不影响心智理论能力，表明核心社会推理在机制上独立。

Conclusion: 当前的安全对齐努力在遏制潜在有害的自我意识归因时，将这些自我归因与良性的灵性信念和对非人类实体的心智归因纠缠在一起，而这些信念在文化上是广泛接受且普遍的。这提示安全对齐需要更精细地解耦不同的归因维度，避免过度压制无害的心智归因能力。

Abstract: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.

</details>

### [173] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种硬件感知的递归Transformer架构评估框架，针对工程设计中常见的小样本、低维数据场景，比较了三种递归Transformer范式（Tiny Recursive Model、Depth Recursive transformer和简单递归transformer）在代理模型（surrogate model）中的表现，并通过半导体封装热机械可靠性分析和Laplace PDE数值求解两个低维工程预测任务验证了递归权重共享在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间提供了有效且可泛化的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Transformer架构在工程设计的低维小数据集上往往过度参数化，导致过拟合而非精度提升，同时带来不必要的内存和计算开销。这促使研究者探索更多关注额外计算而非额外可学习参数的架构，即为递归（权重共享）Transformer范式。

Method: 论文对三种递归Transformer范式进行了硬件感知的评估：(a) Tiny Recursive Model，(b) 提出的Depth Recursive transformer，(c) 简单递归transformer。系统比较了它们的预测性能（Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank）、参数数量和计算复杂度（FLOPs），并在两个低维工程任务上验证：1) 先进半导体封装的热机械可靠性分析（应力与翘曲，替代昂贵的有限元分析）；2) Laplace PDE迭代数值求解器用于电容场计算。

Result: 递归权重共享的Transformer在精度-参数量-计算成本之间展现了有效的权衡。在资源受限场景下，递归架构相比传统Transformer在保持预测精度的同时显著减少了参数和计算开销，为选择递归Transformer架构提供了实用设计指南。

Conclusion: 递归权重共享Transformer为小数据工程代理建模提供了一个有效且可泛化的方案，在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得了良好平衡，适合替代昂贵的首性原理仿真。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [174] [Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27260)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Bin Liu,Tianrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模态贡献漂移（MCD）问题及相应的正则化方法CMCDR，用于解决多模态持续学习中的遗忘问题。CMCDR包含基于回放和无回放两个版本，通过保留先前任务的模态贡献结构来缓解遗忘，在多种多模态持续学习任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMCL方法主要关注跨模态表示对齐或语义相似性，忽视了个体模态及其交互在增量任务中的贡献是否保持稳定。作者将这种决策层面的漂移定义为模态贡献漂移（MCD），并指出当前方法无法可靠地缓解该漂移。

Method: CMCDR通过MCD分数量化模态贡献漂移，包括贡献强度和相对依赖变化。回放版本利用模态子集干预作为诊断探针作用于旧样本，比较当前模型与冻结旧模型的贡献分布；无回放版本则使用当前任务样本作为探针，蒸馏冻结模型的旧任务贡献响应。

Result: 在多模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答任务上的实验验证了CMCDR的普适性和有效性。

Conclusion: CMCDR通过显式约束模态贡献结构的变化，有效缓解了多模态持续学习中的遗忘问题，且适用于有无旧样本回放的不同场景。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to learn emerging knowledge from multimodal data while preserving knowledge. To mitigate forgetting, current MMCL methods usually focus on cross-modal representation alignment or semantic similarity, but they overlook whether the relative contributions of individual modalities and their interactions remain stable across incremental tasks. We term this decision-level shift Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and quantify it with the MCD score, which combines contribution-strength and relative-reliance changes under controlled interventions on modality subsets. Theoretical and empirical analyses further explain why current MMCL methods cannot reliably mitigate this drift. To this end, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR), which preserves the modality contribution structure of previously learned tasks. Since MMCL settings differ in whether old exemplars are available, CMCDR includes both replay-based and replay-free versions. The replay-based version uses modality-subset interventions as diagnostic probes on stored old samples, compares their contribution profiles between the current model and a frozen previous model, and constrains changes in old-sample modality-specific and interaction contributions. The replay-free version uses current-task samples as probes and distills the frozen model's old-task contribution responses, thereby regularizing the observed contribution profile without exemplars. Experiments on multimodal class-incremental learning and continual visual question answering validate the generality and effectiveness of CMCDR.

</details>


### [175] [DoTime: A Synthetic Benchmark Generator for Interventional and Counterfactual Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27263)
*Dennis Thumm,Billy Tim Anthony,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DoTime，一个可扩展、理论奠基的多元时序结构因果模型（TSCM）生成器，支持干预、反事实采样、机制切换和非平稳动态等特性，发布了dotime PyPI包和四个冻结评估套件，并证明了其作为因果基础模型先验的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果推断基准大多是观测性的、规模小或领域特定的，在医疗、政策评估和气候科学等关键场景中，干预性和反事实估计的支持不足。

Method: DoTime生成多元时序结构因果模型（TSCM），具备连续时间干预窗口、带阳性守卫的反事实采样模式、机制切换SCM（严格推广间断时间序列）、通过SCM参数切换构建非平稳动态，以及确定性斜坡和正弦干预轮廓。还实现了因果基础模型参考实现（PFN），验证干预训练的价值。

Result: 发布的套件包含100,000条轨迹的训练规模快照和八种命名识别结构，每种结构都有精确真值。实验表明，在结构匹配的评估下，干预先验拟合网络（PFN）与观测模型相比，在每种结构、轨迹长度和随机种子下都保持正向的方向准确率优势。

Conclusion: 干预训练能带来可测量的方向准确率优势，DoTime生成的干预数据可作为因果基础模型的有效训练先验，支撑可检验的因果推断声明。

Abstract: Most benchmarks for causal inference over time series are observational, small, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served exactly where it matters most, such as in healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science. We introduce \textbf{DoTime}, an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, released as the \code{dotime} PyPI package together with four frozen evaluation suites. Beyond existing work, it adds capabilities absent from prior generators: continuous-time intervention \emph{windows}, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs as a strict generalization of interrupted time series, non-stationary dynamics by construction with switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp and sinusoidal intervention profiles that place trends and structural breaks \emph{inside} the evaluation window. Moreover, it demonstrates the suitability of the generator as a prior for a causal foundation model reference implementation. The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of $100{,}000$ trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth: paired interventional trajectories from the same SCM throughout, and shared-noise counterfactuals in the continuous-time suite. We ship reference baseline implementations with an evaluation harness, and pose a falsifiable claim: interventional training buys a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over an observational model of identical capacity. It is tested across three training seeds per arm. Under structure-matched evaluation on held-out episodes, the interventional prior-fitted network's (PFN) gap is positive in every structure, trajectory length, and seed tested.

</details>


### [176] [QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28415)
*Zhoushun Yu,Xiaoyu Hu,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QQWorld，用分位数-分位数匹配目标替代Epps-Pulley目标来正则化潜在世界模型的潜在分布，解决EP目标在分布尾部梯度消失的问题，从而提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型的规划性能依赖于潜在分布的质量。现有的LeWM使用Epps-Pulley(EP)目标将潜在变量正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但EP的矫正梯度在孤立尾部样本上迅速消失，导致重尾偏差无法被有效控制，影响模型性能。

Method: 提出QQWorld：1) 用分位数-分位数(QQ)匹配目标替代EP目标，直接对齐投影后的潜在样本与秩匹配的高斯分位数，在尾部保持有效的矫正梯度；2) 进一步提出跨批次QQ(cross-batch QQ)，利用之前批次中分离的样本来扩大有效的排序池，并刻画其偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld有效提升了LeWM的平均规划成功率，同时持续获得更好的高斯对齐度和更薄的潜在分布尾部。

Conclusion: QQ匹配目标比EP目标更适合潜在世界模型的正则化，能够在尾部保持有效梯度，从而提升潜在分布质量与规划性能。

Abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

</details>


### [177] [PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27265)
*Shengtian Yang,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Zhiyi Lyu,Bo An,Peng Jiang,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PlatformBid，首个从统一广告平台视角设计的自动出价（auto-bidding）综合基准，涵盖三种真实场景：同质竞争、异质竞争和促销竞争。同时提出基于flow-matching的新方法BidFlow，在快手在线实验中实现目标成本+0.68%的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动出价算法仅从DSP（需求方平台）视角优化广告主转化率，但当前大型广告平台（如社交媒体和电商公司）已内部整合SSP、DSP和Ad Exchange功能。从平台视角看，自动出价不仅需要最大化广告主转化，还需最大化平台整体收入。然而，缺乏以平台为中心的评估框架，阻碍了自动出价研究的发展。

Method: 提出PlatformBid基准，定义三种代表性设置：(1)同质竞争——所有广告主使用相同算法；(2)异质竞争——广告主使用多样化算法策略；(3)促销竞争——部分广告主在促销活动（如黑色星期五）期间激增预算。系统评估了现有自动出价方法（经典控制方法、基于RL的方法、近期生成式方法），并提出基于flow-matching的新方法BidFlow，利用flow-matching的表达性策略表示来应对动态竞争环境。

Result: 在快手（Kuaishou）上进行在线实验，BidFlow在目标成本上实现+0.68%的改进，为PlatformBid的离线-在线一致性提供了部署证据。

Conclusion: PlatformBid是首个从统一广告平台视角设计的自动出价基准，填补了平台中心评估框架的空白，并通过BidFlow展示了flow-matching方法在动态竞争环境中的潜力，同时在线实验验证了基准的可靠性。

Abstract: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.

</details>


### [178] [Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27269)
*Weiye Shi,Fanxu Meng,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端（E2E）的功能重构方法，用于将MHA/GQA模型转换为MLA架构，以提升推测解码（speculative decoding）中草稿token的接受率，而不是简单地做缓存压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA在长上下文LLM推理中具有缓存效率优势，但现有的强开源模型大多使用MHA/GQA架构，需要进行转换。直接转换会因低秩分解和RoPE处理引入注意力函数误差，虽然对独立生成影响不大，但会显著降低推测解码中的草稿-目标一致性，从而影响加速效果。

Method: 将MLA草稿构建视为功能重构（functional reconstruction）而非缓存压缩。E2E方法在转换后，针对每个MLA注意力模块进行优化，使其在标定hidden states上复现原始MHA/GQA模块经过输出投影后的响应。该方法与具体转换器无关，不修改缓存和推理图，也不需要验证器的logits或监督。

Result: 在192种模型-转换器-后端-方法-任务配置上评估，涵盖四对Llama/Qwen草稿-目标对、TransMLA和MHA2MLA转换器、HF和vLLM后端以及四个200提示词任务。在0.5个百分点报告容差下，功能重构在37/64个匹配任务单元中实质性提升接受率，26个基本不变，仅1个实质性下降。

Conclusion: 功能重构作为一种转换器无关的后转换流程，能有效恢复MHA/GQA到MLA转换过程中丢失的注意力功能精度，在不改变转换后缓存和推理图的前提下实质性改善推测解码的草稿接受率，显著优于直接转换方案。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

</details>


### [179] [RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27271)
*Huihao Jing,Haozhe Cui,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Yuxuan Liu,Hanyu Yang,Sirui Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPF（基于性能反馈的强化学习），将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励信号，使代码智能体不仅学会通过测试，还能优化程序运行效率。在PerfCodeBench上，Qwen3-32B微调后正确且可运行的解决方案从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型虽然越来越多地使用执行反馈进行训练，但大多数训练信号仅止步于正确性判断。对于系统代码而言，两个程序可能通过相同测试但运行时差异巨大。因此需要训练代码智能体偏好更快的正确实现，而不仅仅将效率作为评估指标。核心挑战在于运行时奖励是脆弱的：只有在程序正确时才有意义、跨任务差异大、且大多数采样程序无法编译运行时几乎没有指导作用。

Method: RLPF将执行结果转化为分阶段的奖励信号：失败的程序按执行进度排序，正确的程序则根据其相对基准线到专家参考的改进幅度进行排名。这种设计在正确性之前提供有用的反馈，在正确性之后提供性能敏感的反馈。

Result: 在PerfCodeBench上微调Qwen3-32B后，正确且可运行的解决方案从11.1%提升到54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升到38.6%。训练后的模型可与更强的开源系统竞争，优化行为可适度迁移至EffiBench-X。模型生成的参考提供有用但较弱的监督，完整复合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 代码智能体不仅可以通过训练来通过测试，还可以优化其编写的程序的性能。RLPF的分阶段奖励机制成功弥合了正确性与效率之间的差距。

Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

</details>


### [180] [SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27273)
*Jinliang Gao,Ning Yang,Hai Wang,Baili Xiao,Pin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SDO（结构感知数据组织）框架，通过暴露驱动的反馈机制动态组织小批量构成和样本暴露，利用冻结的外部嵌入进行逐epoch操作，无需模型热身训练，在SFT、DPO和GRPO任务上加速收敛并获得更平衡的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型后训练效率优化主要关注样本选择和训练调度，但数据组织本身被当作静态预处理步骤：基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构建固定划分，无法适应优化过程中样本暴露的演化。这导致所有样本获得相似暴露度，忽略了它们不同的优化需求，造成部分样本冗余更新而其他样本欠优化。

Method: SDO在每个epoch内使用KNN邻域遍历实现局部感知的批量组成（locality-aware batching），形成连贯的小批量；在epoch之间通过暴露均衡调度（exposure-balanced scheduling）记录每个样本的参与情况，降低过度暴露样本的采样概率以保持长期覆盖。该方法在冻结的外部嵌入上逐epoch操作，避免了模型热身训练的开销。

Result: 在SFT、DPO和GRPO三种训练范式中，SDO均加速了收敛，在训练早期到中期阶段获益最大，产生更连贯的梯度，在各类问题上取得更平衡的准确率，且不会永久排除训练样本。

Conclusion: SDO作为一种即插即用的数据组织框架，通过暴露驱动的反馈机制有效解决了静态数据组织的局限性，在多种训练范式中展现了通用性和有效性。

Abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

</details>


### [181] [Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27274)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zeyuan Li,Zhiyi Lu,Jiacheng Hao,Youlang Du,Zhen Jiang,Xinche Zhang,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BridgeMIL是一个两阶段的脑电（EEG）疾病诊断框架，将实例表示学习与受试者级监督解耦：第一阶段通过时间邻近窗口和子袋对齐预训练编码器（无需继承标签），第二阶段将编码器迁移到基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者预测施加监督。在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15个设置中取得14个最高平均准确率，整体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的EEG疾病诊断方法将每个受试者的记录分割成短实例并继承受试者标签进行实例级分类，这隐含假设所有实例提供同等可靠的诊断证据，但该假设不成立。多实例学习（MIL）避免了继承标签问题，但EEG数据集中受试者数量远少于实例数量，限制了端到端MIL学习的表示质量。因此需要一种方法既能利用丰富的EEG实例进行学习，又不向单个实例分配疾病标签。

Method: BridgeMIL采用两阶段框架：（1）第一阶段：在无继承实例标签的情况下预训练编码器，通过对齐时间邻近窗口和独立采样的受试者子袋来学习表示，并使用方差和协方差正则化防止坍缩并减少冗余（无需负样本对）；（2）第二阶段：将预训练编码器迁移到基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者预测施加监督，并通过特征保留机制限制表示漂移。

Result: 在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个代表性骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15个数据集-骨干网络组合中的14个上取得最高平均准确率，整体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。进一步分析表明：继承标签可靠性在不同实例间存在显著差异、性能对受试者稀缺比实例稀缺更敏感，以及BridgeMIL学习到了更结构化的表示空间（具有清晰的受试者簇和更好的诊断类别分离）。

Conclusion: 研究强调了将监督与受试者级预测目标对齐的重要性，同时利用丰富的EEG实例进行学习而不给单个实例分配疾病标签。BridgeMIL通过解耦实例表示学习与受试者级监督，有效解决了EEG疾病诊断中继承标签不可靠和受试者样本稀缺的问题，验证了MIL框架在此场景下的有效性。

Abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

</details>
